content: pandas to_sql/read_sql: SQLAlchemy engine is the recommended connection type (supports read_sql_table, transaction rollback, portable across DB backends); raw sqlite3.Connection works for to_sql/read_sql_query but is legacy-only support per pandas docs and cannot roll back inserts. For SQLite panel storage use sqlalchemy.create_engine('sqlite:///path.db') + df.to_sql(name, engine, if_exists='replace', index=False).
